name: Host Inventory
author: karthick-dkk
description: Inventory → Host Inventory: every Linux server, Windows server and website Zabbix monitors, with OS, hostname, architecture, CPU, memory, disks and services read live from their items, and admin-defined fields (client, branch, type, access …) kept as inv: host tags. Bulk edit, CSV import and export, Excel export, websites added with a web check, Zabbix host inventory filled from items.
